messages:
devon: Small follow-up from the postmortem: we need a compact "fast-play" for oncall (0-15m) with copy-paste commands, escalation ladder, and a short list of owners. Can people claim?

jen_sre: I'll write the fast-play and pasteable CLI snippets. Aim: PR in 48h.

chris_platform: I'll take the pre-deploy guard and add a /healthz?cache check that returns eviction_rate. Prototype in 1 week.

maria_pm: I'll own QA acceptance criteria and the two-line CS blurb for fallback routing. 72h.

devon: Draft fast-play bullets pls include: confirm eviction spike, identify affected model/pods, soft-fallback routing, decide rollback/scale, open incident doc.

jen_sre: Sample snippets I'll include: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --since=20m | grep -i eviction`, `kubectl get pods -n inference -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount --sort-by='.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount'`, `curl -fsS https://runtime.internal/healthz?cache=stats`.

devon: Escalation ladder suggestion: oncall -> senior runtime (10m) -> runtime lead (30m) -> infra pager (60m). Incident doc created within 10m. Agree?

maria_pm: Agree. Also add monitor rule: eviction_rate > 0.005 over 10m -> infra pager and a warning ticket to owners.

opsbot: Created ticket <https://tracker.redwood.local/RED-5180|RED-5180> "Fast-play runbook + owners" assigned to jen_sre. Monitor created: eviction_rate > 0.005 over 10m.

devon: Thanks. Reconvene here in 48h to close the runbook and confirm sprint tickets. If blocked ping me or @chris_platform.
